import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import least_squares


def fit_affine_calibration(command: np.ndarray, measured: np.ndarray, groups: np.ndarray,
                           levels: np.ndarray, stress_scale: float, *,
                           historical_coefficients: np.ndarray | None = None,
                           min_span: float = 0.1, consensus_tol: float = 0.002,
                           prior_tol: float = 0.02, slope_tol: float = 0.02
                           ) -> tuple[np.ndarray, int | None, np.ndarray]:
    """Fit positive affine stress gains and biases in levels order.

    Historical candidates are complete sweeps (sweep, group, [gain, bias]),
    oldest first. Select by the equally weighted group median residual score;
    the newest wins ties. Identity is the fallback without history. Stress
    tolerances are fractions of stress_scale; slope_tol is dimensionless.
    Replace a prior independently only with a separated strict majority of
    at least three checks. Otherwise a prior-compatible pair can update the
    line, or compatible individual checks can update only its offset.
    Consensus refinement uses Cauchy loss with twice the residual MAD and
    a floor of 0.1 times consensus_tol, without ridge. Returns coefficients,
    selected sweep index (None without history), and independent-update mask.
    """
    x, y = (np.asarray(v, dtype=float) for v in (command, measured))
    g, levels = np.asarray(groups), np.asarray(levels)
    if x.ndim != 1 or y.shape != x.shape or g.shape != x.shape or levels.ndim != 1:
        raise ValueError('expected aligned check vectors and group levels')
    limits = np.array([stress_scale, min_span, consensus_tol, prior_tol, slope_tol])
    if not np.isfinite(limits).all() or np.any(limits <= 0):
        raise ValueError('stress scale and calibration tolerances must be positive and finite')
    if not np.isfinite(x).all() or not np.isfinite(y).all() or not np.isin(g, levels).all():
        raise ValueError('checks must be finite and belong to the supplied groups')
    x, y = x / stress_scale, y / stress_scale
    picked = None
    out = np.tile([1., 0.], (levels.size, 1))
    if historical_coefficients is not None:
        hist = np.asarray(historical_coefficients, dtype=float)
        if hist.ndim != 3 or hist.shape[1:] != out.shape or not np.isfinite(hist).all() or np.any(hist[..., 0] <= 0):
            raise ValueError('history must contain complete sweeps with positive gains')
        if len(hist):
            hist = hist / [1., stress_scale]
            scores = np.zeros(len(hist))
            for k, level in enumerate(levels):
                sel = g == level
                if sel.any():
                    r = y[sel] - hist[:, k, 0, None] * x[sel] - hist[:, k, 1, None]
                    scores += np.median(np.abs(r), axis=1)
            picked = len(hist) - 1 - int(np.argmin(scores[::-1]))
            out = hist[picked].copy()

    independent = np.zeros(levels.size, dtype=bool)
    for k, level in enumerate(levels):
        a, b = x[g == level], y[g == level]
        i, j = np.triu_indices(a.size, 1)
        dx = a[j] - a[i]
        wide = np.abs(dx) >= min_span
        i, j, dx = i[wide], j[wide], dx[wide]
        slopes = (b[j] - b[i]) / dx
        positive = slopes > 0
        i, j, dx, slopes = i[positive], j[positive], dx[positive], slopes[positive]
        if a.size >= 3 and slopes.size:
            err = np.abs(b[None, :] - b[i, None] - slopes[:, None] * (a[None, :] - a[i, None]))
            inliers = err <= consensus_tol
            counts = inliers.sum(axis=1)
            best = np.lexsort((np.minimum(err, consensus_tol).sum(axis=1), -counts))[0]
            if counts[best] >= max(3, a.size // 2 + 1):
                sel = inliers[best]
                aa, bb = a[sel], b[sel]
                gain = slopes[best]
                start = [gain, np.median(bb - gain * aa)]
                residual = gain * aa + start[1] - bb
                scale = max(2.9652 * np.median(np.abs(residual - np.median(residual))), 0.1 * consensus_tol)
                fit = least_squares(lambda p: p[0] * aa + p[1] - bb, start,
                                    bounds=([0., -np.inf], [np.inf, np.inf]),
                                    loss='cauchy', f_scale=scale)
                out[k] = fit.x
                independent[k] = True
                continue
        residual = b - (out[k, 0] * a + out[k, 1])
        close = np.abs(residual) <= prior_tol
        mismatch = np.abs(residual[j] - residual[i])
        compatible = close[i] & close[j] & (mismatch <= slope_tol * np.abs(dx) + consensus_tol)
        if compatible.any():
            score = mismatch / np.abs(dx) + 0.5 * (np.abs(residual[i]) + np.abs(residual[j]))
            best = np.argmin(np.where(compatible, score, np.inf))
            gain = slopes[best]
            out[k] = [gain, b[i[best]] - gain * a[i[best]]]
        elif close.any():
            out[k, 1] += np.median(residual[close])
    out[:, 1] *= stress_scale
    return out, picked, independent


def align_reference_features(values: np.ndarray, references: np.ndarray,
                             groups: np.ndarray, strata: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Align coupon features and impute from equally weighted observing cells.

    The row-aligned unlabeled reference panel can span fit and evaluation
    specimens. Within a group, signals and controls share an offset and
    positive gain. Use the median reference-column mean and the median
    population standard deviation, requiring repeated observations for
    scale estimation. No variance ridge: a nonpositive reference scale or
    a feature unobserved in all cells raises. Nonfinite entries are missing.
    """
    x, ref = (np.asarray(v, dtype=float) for v in (values, references))
    g, s = np.asarray(groups), np.asarray(strata)
    if x.ndim != 2 or not all(x.shape) or ref.ndim != 2 or len(ref) != len(x) or g.shape != (len(x),) or s.shape != g.shape:
        raise ValueError('expected row-aligned panels and group/stratum vectors')
    x = np.where(np.isfinite(x), x, np.nan)
    ref = np.where(np.isfinite(ref), ref, np.nan)
    aligned = np.empty_like(x)
    cells = []
    for level in np.unique(g):
        rows = g == level
        panel = ref[rows]
        counts = np.isfinite(panel).sum(axis=0)
        if not (counts >= 2).any():
            raise ValueError('each group needs repeated reference observations')
        offset = np.median(np.nanmean(panel[:, counts > 0], axis=0))
        gain = np.median(np.nanstd(panel[:, counts >= 2], axis=0, ddof=0))
        if not np.isfinite(gain) or gain <= 0:
            raise ValueError('reference scale must be positive and finite')
        block = (x[rows] - offset) / gain
        aligned[rows] = block
        for label in np.unique(s[rows]):
            z = block[s[rows] == label]
            count = np.isfinite(z).sum(axis=0)
            cells.append(np.divide(np.nansum(z, axis=0), count,
                                   out=np.full(x.shape[1], np.nan), where=count > 0))
    means = np.asarray(cells)
    if not np.isfinite(means).any(axis=0).all():
        raise ValueError('an entirely missing feature cannot be imputed')
    return np.where(np.isfinite(aligned), aligned, np.nanmean(means, axis=0))


def fit_yield_gated_creep(past_stress: np.ndarray, past_durations: np.ndarray,
                        hold_stress: np.ndarray, hold_times: np.ndarray,
                        features: np.ndarray, initial_strain: np.ndarray,
                        training_rows: np.ndarray, observed_strain: np.ndarray,
                        observed_rate: np.ndarray, yield_stress: float,
                        tau_bounds: tuple[float, float], *, relative_floor: float = 1e-6,
                        sensitivity_min: float = 1e-6) -> dict:
    """Fit two ordered Prony branches, feature drift, and two plastic terms.

    Stresses are calibrated. Histories are piecewise constant, oldest first,
    with shared durations and zero memory before the recorded history. Hold
    stress is constant and features are dimensionless. Observations follow the
    order of training_rows; predictions cover all rows. Rates are the right
    derivative at hold start. Normalize stress by yield and time by max hold
    time. Multistart Cauchy fits use twice the residual MAD with a relative
    floor of 1e-6 and no coefficient ridge. Times and weights are returned in
    the supplied stress/time units. Missing plastic predictors in training
    get zero weights; viscoplastic_extrapolation flags rows requiring them.
    The sensitivity ratio tests local fit geometry, not transfer across labs.
    """
    p, dt, h, t, x, e0, obs, rate = (np.asarray(v, dtype=float) for v in
        (past_stress, past_durations, hold_stress, hold_times, features,
         initial_strain, observed_strain, observed_rate))
    rows = np.asarray(training_rows)
    if p.ndim != 2 or dt.shape != (p.shape[1],) or h.shape != (len(p),) or e0.shape != h.shape or x.ndim != 2 or len(x) != len(p):
        raise ValueError('incompatible history, hold stress, or feature arrays')
    if t.ndim != 1 or t.size < 2 or rows.ndim != 1 or not rows.size or rows.dtype.kind not in 'iu' or np.any(rows < 0) or np.any(rows >= len(p)) or obs.shape != (rows.size, t.size) or rate.shape != rows.shape:
        raise ValueError('incompatible hold times, training indices, or observations')
    if not all(np.isfinite(v).all() for v in (p, dt, h, t, x, e0, obs, rate)):
        raise ValueError('physical arrays and observations must be finite')
    lo, hi = tau_bounds
    if not 0 < yield_stress < np.inf or not 0 < lo < hi < np.inf or np.any(dt < 0) or np.any(t < 0) or np.ptp(t) <= 0 or not 0 < relative_floor < 1 or not 0 < sensitivity_min < 1:
        raise ValueError('invalid yield, time range, bounds, or tolerances')
    S, T = yield_stress, float(t.max())
    p, h, dt, t = p / S, h / S, dt / T, t / T
    after = np.r_[np.cumsum(dt[:0:-1])[::-1], 0.] if dt.size else dt
    over = np.maximum(np.abs(h) - 1., 0.)**2 * np.sign(h)
    work_hold = (np.maximum(np.abs(p) - 1., 0.)**2 @ dt) * h
    has_plastic = np.column_stack((over != 0., work_hold != 0.))
    support = np.any(has_plastic[rows], axis=0)
    nbase = x.shape[1] + 3
    used = np.r_[np.ones(nbase, dtype=bool), support]
    nw = int(used.sum())
    drift = np.column_stack((np.ones(len(x)), x, over))
    linear = np.r_[t, 1.]
    llo, lhi = np.log(np.array([lo, hi]) / T)
    span = lhi - llo

    def logs(q: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
        a, b = q[:2]
        return llo + span * np.array([a, a + (1. - a) * b])

    def design(log_tau: np.ndarray, sel: np.ndarray | slice) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
        columns, derivatives = [], []
        for k, tau in enumerate(np.exp(log_tau)):
            a, b = after / tau, dt / tau
            kernel = np.exp(-a) * -np.expm1(-b)
            dkernel = a * kernel - b * np.exp(-a - b)
            gap = h[sel] - p[sel] @ kernel
            dgap = -(p[sel] @ dkernel)
            u = t / tau
            f = np.r_[-np.expm1(-u), 1. / tau]
            df = np.r_[-u * np.exp(-u), -1. / tau]
            columns.append(gap[:, None] * f)
            derivatives.append(dgap[:, None] * f + gap[:, None] * df)
            if k == 0:
                damage = work_hold[sel, None] * f
                ddamage = work_hold[sel, None] * df
        matrix = np.concatenate((np.stack(columns, axis=-1),
                                 drift[sel, None, :] * linear[None, :, None],
                                 damage[..., None]), axis=-1)
        return matrix, np.stack((*derivatives, ddamage), axis=-1)

    target = np.column_stack((obs - e0[rows, None], rate * T))
    magnitude = np.median(np.abs(target)) or np.max(np.abs(target)) or 1.
    y = target / magnitude

    def unpack(q: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
        w = np.zeros(nbase + 2)
        w[used] = q[2:]
        return w

    def evaluate(q: np.ndarray) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
        A, d = design(logs(q), rows)
        w = unpack(q)
        fast = d[..., 0] * w[0] + d[..., 2] * w[-1]
        slow = d[..., 1] * w[1]
        J = np.concatenate((fast[..., None], slow[..., None], A[..., used]), axis=-1)
        return A @ w - y, J

    def mad(v: np.ndarray, axis: int | None = None) -> np.ndarray:
        return 1.4826 * np.median(np.abs(v - np.median(v, axis=axis, keepdims=True)), axis=axis)

    def run(q: np.ndarray, scales: np.ndarray):
        def residual(z: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
            return (evaluate(z)[0] / scales).ravel()

        def jacobian(z: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
            _, J = evaluate(z)
            J[..., 0] = span * (J[..., 0] + (1. - z[1]) * J[..., 1])
            J[..., 1] *= span * (1. - z[0])
            return (J / scales[:, None]).reshape(-1, nw + 2)

        bounds = (np.r_[0., 1e-6, np.full(nw, -np.inf)],
                  np.r_[1. - 1e-6, 1., np.full(nw, np.inf)])
        return least_squares(residual, q, jac=jacobian, bounds=bounds,
                             loss='cauchy', x_scale='jac', max_nfev=250, ftol=1e-9)

    starts, pilots = [], []
    for a, end in ((.12, .58), (.25, .75), (.42, .88), (.05, .94), (.55, .92)):
        q = np.array([a, (end - a) / (1. - a)])
        A = design(logs(q), rows)[0][..., used].reshape(-1, nw)
        w = np.linalg.lstsq(A, y.ravel(), rcond=None)[0]
        starts.append(np.r_[q, w])
        pilots.append((A @ w).reshape(y.shape) - y)
    rough = min(pilots, key=lambda r: np.median(np.abs(r)))
    scales = np.maximum(2. * mad(rough, axis=0), relative_floor)
    best = min((run(q, scales) for q in starts), key=lambda fit: fit.cost)
    for _ in range(2):
        r, _ = evaluate(best.x)
        scales = np.maximum(2. * np.r_[np.full(t.size, mad(r[:, :-1])), mad(r[:, -1])], relative_floor)
        best = run(best.x, scales)
    r, J = evaluate(best.x)
    J /= (scales * np.hypot(1., r / scales))[..., None]
    sv = np.linalg.svd(J.reshape(-1, nw + 2), compute_uv=False)
    ratio = float(sv[-1] / sv[0]) if sv.size == nw + 2 and sv[0] > 0 else 0.
    theta = unpack(best.x) * magnitude
    log_tau = logs(best.x)
    pred = design(log_tau, slice(None))[0] @ theta
    return dict(time_constants=np.exp(log_tau) * T,
                hereditary_weights=theta[:nbase] / np.r_[S, S, np.full(nbase - 2, T)],
                viscoplastic_weights=theta[nbase:] / np.array([S**2 * T, S**3 * T]),
                strain=e0[:, None] + pred[:, :-1], initial_rate=pred[:, -1] / T,
                overstressed=np.maximum(np.max(np.abs(p), axis=1, initial=0.), np.abs(h)) > 1.,
                viscoplastic_support=support,
                viscoplastic_extrapolation=np.any(has_plastic & ~support, axis=1),
                sensitivity_ratio=ratio, identifiable=bool(best.success and ratio > sensitivity_min))

    assert_allclose(other['time_constants'], q * fit['time_constants'], rtol=2e-5)
    assert_allclose(other['hereditary_weights'], fit['hereditary_weights'] / [s, s, q, q, q], rtol=2e-5)
    assert_allclose(other['viscoplastic_weights'], fit['viscoplastic_weights'] / [s**2 * q, s**3 * q], rtol=2e-5)
    assert_allclose(other['strain'], fit['strain'], atol=2e-7, rtol=0)
    assert_allclose(other['initial_rate'], fit['initial_rate'] / q, atol=2e-7, rtol=0)

    sub = np.arange(24, n)
    linear = fit_yield_gated_creep(past, dt, hold, t, features, e0, sub, strain[sub], rate[sub], sy, (.25, 4.))
    assert linear['identifiable']
    assert_array_equal(linear['viscoplastic_weights'], [0., 0.])
    assert_array_equal(linear['viscoplastic_support'], [False, False])
    assert linear['viscoplastic_extrapolation'][12] and not linear['viscoplastic_extrapolation'][24]
    assert_allclose(linear['time_constants'], tau, rtol=2e-4)
    assert_allclose(linear['strain'][sub], strain[sub], atol=2e-7, rtol=0)


run_self_test()
